description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of different reasoning hierarchies and the impact of using noise as input on the MMAR benchmark. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 60. The horizontal axis lists three reasoning hierarchies: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Ommi. The blue bars represent the accuracy of the Audio hierarchy, the purple bars represent the accuracy of the Noise hierarchy, and the dashed line represents the accuracy of Random Choice. The Qwen2-Audio-Instruct hierarchy has an accuracy of around 30%, the Audio-Reasoner hierarchy has an accuracy of around 40%, and the Qwen-2.5-Ommi hierarchy has an accuracy of around 50%. The Noise hierarchy has an accuracy of around 20% for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, around 30% for Audio-Reasoner, and around 40% for Qwen-2.5-Ommi. The Random Choice has an accuracy of around 30% for all three hierarchies.
